claim_scope: Label-free development diagnostic for GAFF2/OBC-II/ACE reference sampling followed by sparse energy-only evaluation of the exact Route 1 MLIP/OBC-II/ACE target and indirect gas/solution free-energy corrections. This protocol cannot establish equilibrium, universal acceleration, chemical accuracy, confirmation, or product promotion.

route_contract.name: Additive fixed-charge PB/GB implicit solvation
route_contract.formal_model_agnosticism: Any registered gas-phase MLIP that supplies finite energies on every audited configuration can be evaluated; practical efficiency remains overlap-limited.

thermodynamic_cycle.reference_solvation_estimator: PyMBAR MBAR from GAFF2 gas and GAFF2/OBC-II/ACE samples
thermodynamic_cycle.indirect_correction_estimator: PyMBAR MBAR for bidirectional validation, with BAR as an independent two-state cross-check
thermodynamic_cycle.accelerated_candidate: Reference-only PyMBAR EXP corrections with sparse target energy evaluations

reference_potential.solution: GAFF2 fixed-charge molecular mechanics plus OpenMM OBC-II/ACE
reference_potential.charges: The same frozen AM1-BCC vector used by the Route 1 target
reference_potential.radii: Amber mbondi2 embedded in the frozen topology

analysis.standard_state: gas 1 M to ideal-dilute solution 1 M; configurational indirect correction

decision_policy.reason: The frozen trajectories are deliberately short and cannot establish equilibrium or conformer mixing. Reference-only acceleration remains unvalidated even if numerical overlap gates pass.
decision_policy.poor_overlap_action: fail closed or add intermediate reference-to-target states; never silently trust endpoint FEP

forbidden_claims: faster than a bare MM force evaluation
universally faster for every molecule or MLIP
accurate without an overlap and uncertainty audit

literature.role: MM-to-QM energy reweighting for solvation free energies

literature.citation: Tkaczyk S et al. J Chem Theory Comput 20, 2719-2728 (2024).
literature.role: MM reference to ANI-2x target free-energy reweighting

literature.citation: Wang Y et al. J Chem Theory Comput 21, 6979-6987 (2025).
literature.role: multi-MLIP free-energy workflow precedent and interface evidence

limitations: Reference trajectories are only 3 ps per endpoint replicate including 0.5 ps discarded by construction.
The three target-model endpoint trajectories are only the production subsets of the prior 30 fs development diagnostic.
The three molecules and three registered MLIPs are a development matrix, not a confirmation benchmark.
Bidirectional BAR consumes direct target samples only to audit the cheaper reference-only EXP candidate; it is not part of the claimed accelerated production path.
No experimental FreeSolv labels may be opened until the label-free energy artifact is sealed.
